name: Spinneret
title: A scraping pipeline that fixes itself in CI.
description: When a scraper fails, Spinneret works out why. If the scraper itself broke, it repairs it automatically and re-checks the output. If the website genuinely changed, it records the change and leaves the scraper alone. It runs on GitHub Actions and stores data in Git, so broken rows never reach the published dataset.

name: Palladium
title: An open-source explorer for every Avalanche L1.
description: Palladium finds every Avalanche L1, tracks its health, and shows it on a public dashboard and a REST API. A four-step pipeline discovers chains, indexes validators, adds up TVL, and collects EVM metrics, keeping 90 days of history for every chain.

name: Clarity
title: Turn ChatGPT conversations into summaries and mind maps.
description: Paste a ChatGPT share link and Clarity reads the whole conversation, then uses LLMs (via OpenRouter) to pull out a summary, key insights, action items, and overall tone. Results stream in live and the conversation is laid out as an interactive mind map.

name: Jerico
title: Crypto invoicing with instant PYUSD payments.
description: A mobile-first app for freelancers and businesses to send invoices and get paid in PYUSD on Ethereum. Invoices are created on-chain and shared as a link or QR code, and payment goes straight from the client's wallet to yours, with no middleman holding the funds.

name: ScanLens
title: Name, tag, and color Solana addresses right on Solscan.
description: A Chrome extension that lets you give Solana wallet addresses a name, tags, and a color, and shows those labels inline wherever the address appears on Solscan. Everything is stored on your device and Solscan's links keep working as normal.

name: Terms-Simplified
title: Spot risky Terms & Conditions before you accept them.
description: A browser extension that reads a website's Terms & Conditions with AI and flags the clauses worth worrying about: unfair account termination, data sharing, auto-renewals, and limits on liability. Your API key and results stay on your device, with no tracking.

name: Share-on-Network
title: Open your local Next.js app on any device on the same Wi-Fi.
description: A small utility that makes your Next.js dev server reachable from other devices on your local network using your machine's IP address. Handy for checking a page on your phone or tablet without deploying it.

name: Safe Deploy
title: Deploy smart contracts from the CLI without exposing your private key.
description: An npm package you run from the terminal against a locally compiled contract. It then opens a browser page where MetaMask signs the deployment, so your private key never touches your dev environment. Runs entirely on localhost with no external services.

name: Open Funds
title: An on-chain alternative to OpenCollective, built on NEAR.
description: A crowdfunding platform on the NEAR blockchain where creators and project teams can collect donations in the open. Every project and contribution is stored on-chain, so anyone can verify where the money came from and no one can take a project down.

name: Type It All
title: A fast, clean one-minute typing test.
description: A typing-speed test that pulls fresh random text from an API and shows your words per minute and accuracy as you type. When you're done, share your score on Twitter and challenge your friends.

name: Name It
title: Startup name ideas, with a one-click domain check.
description: Type a few keywords and get related name ideas for your startup or project, generated with an open-source word-association library. Each suggestion links straight to a domain search so you can see if it's available.

name: Solana Wedding
title: A wedding registry on the Solana blockchain.
description: A wedding registry running on Solana Devnet where couples can record moments and gifts permanently on-chain. It stores only the essentials on-chain to keep transactions fast and cheap.

name: NFT Emporium
title: Mint NFTs on multiple chains without writing code.
description: A simple app for minting NFTs on Polygon, Ethereum, BSC, and more. Moralis handles the backend, so creators can mint through a clean interface without any blockchain know-how or setup.

name: NASA App
title: Browse NASA's Astronomy Picture of the Day, week by week.
description: A viewer for NASA's Astronomy Picture of the Day that groups photos by week so they're easier to browse. Images load lazily and API requests are batched, so it stays fast even when scrolling far back.
